data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'kulafah', meaning 'fortress' or 'stronghold'. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kulfah usually hope their child will grow to embody fortress, stronghold and live with faith, good character and purpose.
